mechanism: Measured from tests/unit/test_stream_path_full_frame_compare.sh on stream_path_full_frame_tb. Per-stage cycle accounting via stub_busy/fs_wr_reset/fs_swap phase transitions. Product multi-MB path (h264_p_mb_traverse + PH_FETCH + PH_DPB_FILL 384-sample ref-commit per MB) is still attributed to parse_cavlc until a dedicated MC/DPB stage split exists. Aggregate cycles/MB also includes diagnostic paint. Deblock/DDR product write remain partial.

stage_coverage.name: stream_path_total_current
stage_coverage.note: Includes ioctl byte feed, Annex-B scanner/SPS/PPS/slice parse, product multi-MB inter FETCH+DPB_FILL ref-commit, residual/diagnostic path, and diagnostic frame emission.

stage_coverage.name: parse_cavlc_dequant_idct_intra_breakdown
stage_coverage.note: Existing simulation reports aggregate cycles and MB0 trace, not separate per-stage cycle counters.

stage_coverage.name: inter_mc_dpb_deblock_product_writeback
stage_coverage.note: Product path walks P MBs via h264_p_mb_traverse and streams 384 samples/MB into h264_dpb_ref_commit; cost currently folded into parse_cavlc (stub_busy). Full deblock/DDR writeback stage split still pending.

stage_coverage.name: parse_cavlc
stage_coverage.note: stub_busy window: Annex-B parse + product multi-MB FETCH/DPB_FILL. Not pure CAVLC once multi-MB product commit is live.

stage_coverage.name: intra_pred
stage_coverage.note: Zero additional clock cycles. DC Intra_4x4 prediction is combinational.

stage_coverage.name: mc_interpolation
stage_coverage.note: Partial: product FETCH uses DPB MC window; cost folded into parse_cavlc until stage split.

stage_coverage.name: deblock
stage_coverage.note: In-loop deblock_mb runs on product commit path but is not yet a separate throughput stage.

measured_baseline.note: integ/rtl-consol product multi-MB: trav walk + MVP/mvd fetch + 384-sample dpb_ref_commit per MB. parse_cavlc bucket includes FETCH+DPB_FILL until stage split. strict_pass still expected-red vs host golden.
